about: Additionally, through our extensive line-up of materials handling equipment including cranes, lift trucks and warehouse trucks , oasis bird extends its services to an even wider variety of industries.

The material handling division of Oasis Bird Group is responsible for the growing sales of Hangcha forklifts in the UAE, with the company taking the brand to new heights in the region. Hangcha forklift trucks are supported by the prompt and reliable after sales back up from Oasis Bird making them the first choice for forklift truck buyers in the UAE.
